title: pprofit20: calibrated probability that a long / short entered NOW is profitable after costs, per instrument, M5
before_registration: check mode only: feature quantiles and row counts on 2018-2022 (out/explore.json). No label, net R or fill was computed before this file.
data: engine/cache M1 bid/ask npz (newest per instrument), cut at 2026-10-07T18:30 UTC; M5 by bars.resample; H1 = M5 resampled on the hour; production supertrend (flips.mjs, ATR10, mult 3) on mid M5 and mid H1

trade.entry: open of the M5 bar after the decision bar; long at the ask, short at the bid
trade.stop: 1R = 1.5 x Wilder ATR14 of mid M5 at the decision bar (operator spec; the 308 policy otherwise used the supertrend ATR10 as the R base)
trade.management: labels_v2.POLICY: breakeven after +1R (one-bar latency), 3R target, exit at the next open after an opposite M5 supertrend flip, time exit after 72 bars; bid/ask exits
trade.label: y = 1 if net R > 0 (a breakeven exit at exactly 0 R is y = 0); net R stored for the expected-R readout
trade.censoring: rows whose trade is still open at the data cut are dropped

population: every M5 bar whose start minute % 15 == 10 (every 3rd bar, the M15 close), all hours incl. thin hours and session opens; two rows per bar (long, short); rows need finite ATR14, the 1440-bar ATR mean, nonzero M5 and completed-H1 supertrend trend
timeframes: M5 only; M15 declared skipped (time box)

side_free.h_s1..h_c3: sin/cos of K x 2pi x minute-of-day of the decision bar close, K = 1, 2, 3
side_free.mon, fri: trading-day (22:00 UTC roll) Monday / Friday flags
side_free.lrv12, lrv72: log(RMS of mid close changes over 12 / 72 bars / ATR14), clip [-3, 3]
side_free.latr: log(ATR14 / mean ATR14 over the last 1440 bars), clip [-3, 3]
side_free.lrng: log(range so far today / ATR14) clip [-5, 5] minus the per-5-minute-slot median of the same quantity on the fit rows (time-of-day norm, refitted per fold)

side_signed (x side).burst: sign of the 3-bar close change if |change| / ATR14 > 2.5, else 0

features.causality: all features use bars <= the decision bar; H1 bars only when completed

model.primary: per instrument L2 logistic regression (sklearn, C = 1.0) on x = [z(18 features), side, side x z(18 features)], z = standardisation on the fit rows
model.comparator: HistGradientBoosting (200 iter, lr 0.05, 31 leaves, min leaf 200, l2 1.0) on the 18 features + slot + side, yearly refit, raw probabilities; AUC and CITL only
model.refit: quarterly expanding: for quarter start Qs, fit rows = trade exit < Qs - 182 days; calibration rows = start in [Qs - 182 d, Qs) and exit < Qs; predict rows starting in the quarter. First quarter 2019Q1
model.calibration: Platt (logistic on the raw score) fitted on the calibration window only

windows.w2023: 2023-01-01..cut, DEVELOPMENT window (inspected by earlier campaigns), same procedure continued

validation_rule.primary_calibration: PASS per instrument iff, in BOTH windows and for EACH side, every decile of predicted P (equal-count, per side and window) with n >= 1000 has |mean P - observed frequency| <= 0.03
validation_rule.reported: AUC per side and window (and per year); P10/P50/P90 of P per side; P by 4-hour UTC block and by spread bucket with observed rate and mean R; CITL by year; HGB AUC; long-minus-short distribution, its decile table and slope of observed (y_long - y_short) on predicted difference with 5-day block-bootstrap CI (500 reps); mean net R, avg win, avg loss by decile with 5-day moving-block day-bootstrap CI (1000 reps)
validation_rule.edge_rule: never claimed; report deciles whose mean net R CI lies above 0 (expected R > 0 is equivalent to P x avg win > (1 - P) x |avg loss|)

export: if an instrument passes: out/artifact_<INST>_pprofit20.json (feature order and definitions, tod_norm table, scaler, coefficients incl. side interaction, intercept, Platt a/b, training cutoff, code hash, validity statement, expected-R lookup by out-of-sample P decile per side). Final model = the same scheme with Qs = cut. Parity fixtures for WTI and EUR/USD (out/parity_<INST>_pprofit20.json): last 6000 M5 bid/ask bars, the last 200 cadence bars x 2 sides with features computed from those bars only, raw score and P; tolerance 1e-9. For a failing instrument the fixture artifact is written and marked do-not-ship.
rules: no test ledger; nothing marked qualified; trials logged to trials.jsonl with exp pprofit20
